summary: Retested mobile branding, registration, item creation, reveal, copy, delete, logout, Google link, and recovery. Registration/create/reveal worked; copy caused a runtime clipboard permission overlay that blocked delete/logout.

integration_issues.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText rejects with NotAllowedError in the preview browser; the rejection is uncaught, triggering the webpack runtime-error overlay and blocking subsequent delete/logout interaction.

action_items: Handle clipboard permission/API failures in copy() with a caught error and user-facing fallback or message so the app does not crash/overlay.
Load frontend/.env or set REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in backend pytest configuration before running the regression suite.
critical_code_review_comments: The copy handler awaits navigator.clipboard.writeText without try/catch; browser permission denial becomes an uncaught React runtime error and prevents all later vault actions.

success_rate.backend: 100% (recovery spot check; pytest collection blocked by test config)

seed_data_creation: Created disposable TEST_mobile_* users and TEST mobile secret items during UI runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: TopPass5 title/visible mobile branding, Google link, registration, item creation, masked-to-plaintext reveal, and mobile logout visibility were verified up to the copy step. Copy permission handling remains unresolved; delete/logout could not complete after the overlay appeared.
rca of the issue: Vault.copy() directly awaits navigator.clipboard.writeText(values[id]||'') without catch handling. In this preview/mobile context clipboard-write permission is denied, causing an uncaught NotAllowedError. The webpack dev overlay intercepts pointer events, so the delete button times out. Add try/catch and avoid allowing rejected clipboard promises to escape.
